column1: # Lalivero interiors: the report to Faran and the search for Sheba.
# First account of the search and the fate of Idejima.

column3: We searched...{pause_20_skippable} There\nwas no sign of her.{end_wait}
The sea is too rough.\nNo boat can get close\nto where she fell.{end_wait}
We searched the shore.\nThere was nothing.{end_wait}
Tolbi brought {actor_name:7}\ninto this. We cannot\ndeny our part in it.{end_wait}
I have no words that\ncan make this right,\nFaran.{end_wait}
We have not found\n{actor_name:7}. But that does\nnot mean she is gone.{end_wait}
And what of {actor_name:6}\nand the others?{end_wait}
We found no trace\nof them, either.{end_wait}
The shock from Venus\nsplit the land apart.\nThe ship...{end_wait}
Idejima broke away.\nThe ship went out\nto sea with it.{end_wait}
The whole peninsula\nwas swept out to sea?{end_now}
Then the passage\nbeneath the lighthouse\nmust be flooded.{end_wait}
We believe {actor_name:6}\nand the others\nmay still be alive.{end_wait}
If they reached\nthe ship, the current\nmay have carried them.{end_wait}
We will keep looking\nfor {actor_name:6}. We owe\nher that much.{end_wait}
Isn't that right,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}

column1: # Faran's response, the Adept discussion, and the farewell.

column3: Please do not give up\non {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
We will search for\n{actor_name:7} as long as\nwe are able.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} has survived\nthings no one else\ncould have endured.{end_wait}
But that fall...\nEven I cannot say\nwhat happened to her.{end_wait}
The sea rose as she\nfell. None of us\nexpected that.{end_wait}
You call that\na miracle?{end_wait}
Or was it only\na stroke of luck?{end_wait}
We cannot know yet.\nCall it chance.{end_wait}
I raised her.\nNothing about her\nwas ever ordinary.{end_wait}
Then you truly think\n{actor_name:7} is alive?{end_wait}
I have to believe\nshe is.{end_wait}
You believe {actor_name:7}\nsurvived because\nshe is an Adept?{end_wait}
An Adept? I have\nnever heard that word.{end_wait}
It's hard to explain.{end_wait}
Someone who can use\npowers like ours.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, your friends\nand you have done\nwhat we could not.{end_wait}
You found a way\nthrough the ruins\nto Venus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
But {actor_name:7} could not\npass through the ruins.\nWhy was that?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} has powers\nunlike theirs. That is why\nshe could not enter.{end_wait}
I've told Faran this\nagain and again, but he\nstill will not believe me!{end_wait}
{actor_name:2}, that is\nunfair...{end_wait}
We cannot stay here.\nWe have to go.{end_wait}
Of course. I did not\nmean to keep you...{end_wait}
That did not come\nout as I intended...{end_wait}
While we speak,\n{actor_name:6} and the others\nare still lost at sea.{end_wait}
I understand. You cannot\nafford to wait.{end_wait}
The sea has been rough\nsince the beacon was lit.\nBe careful!{end_wait}
You, too. Farewell.{end_wait}
Take care...\nand farewell!{end_wait}
Thank you. I hope your\nsearch for {actor_name:7}\nends in success.{end_wait}

column1: # Alternate report when the party did not see the ship at Idejima.

column3: The same. We searched\neverywhere, but found\nno sign of them.{end_wait}
The shock from the\nlighthouse tore the\nground apart...{end_wait}
Then Idejima itself\nwas swept out to sea...{end_wait}
My goodness... Then\n{actor_name:6} and the others\nmust have...{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} said he sent\n{actor_name:6} ahead to the\nship from the lighthouse.{end_wait}
But we believe they\nsurvived.{end_wait}
They may have been\ncarried out to sea\nwith Idejima...{end_wait}
We will keep searching\nfor {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Isn't that right,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}
You will find {actor_name:6}.\nI believe that...\nFarewell.{end_wait}
